exit_state: The Apple asset alternatives need different remainders:History2 requires1000 less liability growth and1000 more profit/equity elsewhere. An expense offset preserves totals only under extra facts;individual cash-flow rows require disjoint mapping with alpha1 in this construction. Actual whole-company completion remains unestablished. Equal liabilities3082 still give different operating/investing and timed cash paths. The lease/tax case reconciles gross DTA/DTL and later tax payment under supplied law. Apple's current-tax and deferred-balance residuals4901 and-1080 remain unexplained movements;the State Aid charge discussion has begun and continues next.

findings.observation: The progression distinguishes local feasibility,necessary remainder arithmetic,conditional row invariance and actual company-history admission. Shared-history dependence excludes Cartesian combinations of marginal cash categories. Neither positive remaining payments nor matched total cash establishes a real continuation.
